blocks.text: NEW ORLEANS — Jeremiah Fears had 19 points, 10 assists and 10 rebounds for his first career triple-double, and the New Orleans Pelicans snapped a six-game losing streak with a 115-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Monday night. Saddiq Bey, who hit five 3-pointers, scored 23 points and Zion Williamson added 16 for New Orleans, which led 35-11 after one quarter and maintained a lead that grew as large as 31 points in the third quarter.
